purpose: APASA interface and planning workflow demonstration only; not for analysis or policy decisions
geographic_label_input: outputs/day7/official_sas_2026_b_district.csv; administrative names and IDs only, not statistical values

district.coverage: Illustrative aggregate crop coverage; no sampled population or household records
assumptions: Place, crop and period indices follow generator list order, starting at zero
Production MT = harvested hectares * yield Kg/Ha / 1000
Nyarugenge Cassava 2025 B yield and production are true-zero examples
Huye Bush bean 2026 A yield and production are intentionally missing, not zero
Seasons are separate observations; no annual sum, ranking or policy-target comparison
All annual values and targets are invented
PSTA5 is an example framework selection, not a claim that these targets appear in PSTA5
Annual planning examples and seasonal district examples are separate datasets and must not be joined
No standard errors, sample sizes, survey verification or intervention effects are claimed

legacy_previews.policy_missing_actual: Only when explicitly requested and actual is unverified: value 1000 in the target unit, which does not verify an actual unit. No progress calculation.
legacy_previews.national_workbook_unavailable_cells: Only when explicitly requested: illustrative value 1000 for MT, 1 for MT/ha, otherwise 50 in source units. Original source_value retained separately. Observed values and real zeros are never replaced.
legacy_previews.source_inputs: Existing source labels and unavailable-cell positions only, not numerical inputs to generate replacement values.
